hafen.titel: the stranger who held the quay against the animals

kloster.titel: the man who came back from San Martinu with a lion story

grotte.titel: the smugglers' grotto and the third step

sirene.titel: singing from the point at night

kevin.titel: the duel on the bell tower

red_trio.titel: three people in red and the jacket

hafen.rosi.zeit.0.text: Officer. I checked the bat after the quay. Not one dent. The bat is fine. Your technique is a disaster, but the bat is fine.

hafen.lola.zeit.0.text: Mate, Alva's telling everyone you fought the dogs off on your own. Don't tell anyone I told you, but I reckon she fancies you a bit. Mostly the bat.

hafen.maxwell.zeit.0.text: Number One! The village says you knocked out a wild boar with one swing. Mr. Maximum is proud of you, brother. Mr. Maximum would also like to see the footwork.

hafen.chiara.zeit.0.text: On Tuesday the rats were twelve. Tonight at the bar they were forty, and one of them wore a little hat. I give the story a six. The hat was a nice touch.

hafen.elsa.zeit.0.text: First Officer. I have six statements about the harbour, and in four of them you are taller than you are. I am filing the other two.

hafen.sophia.zeit.0.text: Darling, in the latest version you ride the boar up the town hall steps. Ten euros says that by Friday it's a bear.

hafen.jana.zeit.0.text: Sorry, Sir, sorry, is it true you threw the confetti cannon at the boar? Lola says yes and Chiara says don't ask, so I'm asking. Sorry.

hafen.danzel.zeit.0.text: So you're the man who held the quay with a baseball bat. Three boars, they say. One boar, I say. And your jacket, if I may, was the real crime.

hafen.alva.laden.0.text: Look who it is, the man who saved my bar door with a stick. Your first drink is still free, o figliolu. The second one we can negotiate.

hafen.petru.laden.0.text: Hm. They say you threw the boar into the sea. You didn't. But my boat is still blue. Sit.

hafen.toto.laden.0.text: Comandante! In my version I was right beside you on the quay. Behind a crate, yes, but beside you. Strategically.

hafen.nonna.laden.0.text: So you're the one who fought three hundred rats with a broom. Sit down. A man who does that eats twice.

kloster.lea.zeit.0.text: A lion, Duc. On Corsica. There have never been lions on Corsica, which means somebody brought one, and that's proper worse.

kloster.casanova.zeit.0.text: Monsieur. My father's spear. I gave it to you in front of everyone and I would do it again tomorrow. With better music.

kloster.siri.zeit.0.text: Sorry, I keep thinking about the monks up there. You don't have to tell me anything. I just didn't want you to think nobody asked.

kloster.yasin.zeit.0.text: Bro. Lion hunter. Do you know what that does on a thumbnail? Don't say anything, just stand next to the spear and look tired. That's business.

kloster.toto.zeit.0.text: Comandante, at the harbour they say the lion was as big as a fishing boat. I said bigger. Now they believe me more than they believe you.

kloster.yamamoto.zeit.0.text: Officer-san, so sorry. In the village they say you wrestled the lion and the lion apologised. Very interesting. I would like a photograph of the lion. From far away.

kloster.chiara.zeit.0.text: Alva's version is that you carried the lion home on your back and Nonna cooked it. I give it a three. Nonna would never cook a lion, it's too tough.

kloster.bibi.zeit.0.text: You let him go. He's out there now, somewhere in the macchia, lying in the sun with nobody telling him what to do. I bet he has a lovely life. Thank you, Duc. Really.

kloster.bibi.zeit.1.text: I still put out his bowl in the mornings. Isn't that stupid? He was this big when I got him, and now there's nothing left to feed. I keep waiting to hear him snore.

kloster.nonna.laden.0.text: The boy brings the harvest down every morning now, and he says your name like it belongs to a saint. Don't let it go to your head. Eat.

kloster.nonna.laden.1.text: Sit. Don't talk. Some days a kitchen is only for being quiet in.

kloster.isabelle.laden.0.text: Officer! Frederico carved you a lion. It has five legs, and he says the fifth one is for luck. I said nothing. I also want one.

kloster.alva.laden.0.text: Half my bar says you killed the lion and the other half says you let it go. Tell me which, o figliolu, and I'll tell you which half pays tonight.

kloster.rosi.laden.0.text: Officer. The village says the lion followed you home and sleeps in Nonna's barn now. If that's true, I'm building it a kennel. A big one.

berge.sophia.zeit.0.text: Petru walked past me at the harbour this morning and nodded. Petru doesn't nod, darling. Whatever you did up there, he's counting it.

berge.sophia.zeit.1.text: Petru's shop has been dark for two days, and nobody in the village says your name near it. I'm only telling you because nobody else will.

berge.maxwell.zeit.0.text: Brother, you climbed the whole mountain and came down with both legs. Mr. Maximum respects that. Mr. Maximum also wants to hear about the bridge.

berge.lola.zeit.0.text: Mate, Alva says Petru cried. Petru! I didn't know he had water in him. Mostly salt, I reckon.

berge.lea.zeit.0.text: They're saying there's a bear up there the size of a car and you shook paws with it. Bears don't shake paws. That's proper rude of the village, to the bear.

berge.siri.zeit.0.text: Sorry, is it true there's a black panther up there that only you can see? The baker's daughter told me. I'm scared and I also want to go.

berge.petru.laden.0.text: Hm. On Sunday there is fish pie. You come. Don't bring anything.

berge.petru.laden.1.text: Hm. She doesn't speak to you. She doesn't speak much to me either. Take what you need.

berge.alva.laden.0.text: The tower story gets better every night, o figliolu. Tonight you climbed it without a rope. Tomorrow, I think, without trousers.

berge.nonna.laden.0.text: They say you carried a soldier down the mountain over your shoulder, like a lamb. Sit down. Carrying soldiers makes a man hungry.

grotte.toto.zeit.0.text: Comandante. You went in with the tide coming. Nobody does that for my family. Nobody. I don't forget things like that.

grotte.lea.zeit.0.text: You went past the third step. I watched the water from the deck the whole time, counting. Don't do that again. Or do, but tell me first.

grotte.maxwell.zeit.0.text: Number One goes into a cave full of smugglers and comes back with a cousin! Eish. Mr. Maximum goes to the shop and comes back with milk.

grotte.rosi.zeit.0.text: The village says there were rails in that cave and you rode a mine cart out of it. Officer, if there's a mine cart, I want it. For science.

grotte.sophia.zeit.0.text: The new version: you found the smugglers' treasure and gave all of it to the church. Ten euros says the priest believes it.

grotte.alva.laden.0.text: Totò was in here last night and didn't make a single bet. Not one. Whatever happened in that cave, o figliolu, it got to him.

grotte.lola.laden.0.text: Boss! They're saying you swam out of that cave with a smuggler on your back. Don't tell anyone I told you, but I already told Chiara it was two.

grotte.petru.laden.0.text: Hm. My grandfather said nobody comes out of that cave with the tide. You did. So my grandfather was wrong. First time.

sirene.sophia.zeit.0.text: You came back at three in the morning, soaking wet and smelling of the sea, darling. Chiara has a theory. I have a bet.

sirene.chiara.zeit.0.text: First Officer. You took the tender out alone, at night, against my rota. I give the idea a two. Whatever you found out there, I'm still deciding.

sirene.yasin.zeit.0.text: Bro, the village says there's a mermaid. If there's a mermaid and you didn't film her, we need to talk about your priorities.

sirene.jana.zeit.0.text: Sorry, Sir. Lola says your new girlfriend is half a fish. Is it the top half or the bottom half? Sorry. Na geh, forget I asked.

sirene.petru.laden.0.text: Hm. Last night there was singing from the point. My grandfather heard it once, in nineteen twenty-four. You were out there. Hm.

sirene.alva.laden.0.text: Somebody saw you rowing out alone at night, o figliolu. Half the village thinks you have a lover in the rocks, and the other half thinks you're mad. I'm in both halves.

sirene.nonna.laden.0.text: They say a woman sings in the sea and you sang back. My mother had a word for men who sing back. Eat first, then I'll tell you.

kevin.lea.zeit.0.text: You got page forty back! Kevin's going to be furious, proper furious. I'm going to frame it. The page, not Kevin.

kevin.lola.zeit.0.text: Mate, my good fork was in that nest. My good fork! Kevin's a thief and you're a hero. Mostly a hero.

kevin.rosi.zeit.0.text: Officer. They say you screamed at a seagull from the bell tower until the seagull left. I respect it. That's how I talk to the generator.

kevin.siri.zeit.0.text: Sorry, the whole village watched you on the church roof? Yasin is so annoyed he missed it. I'm a little bit proud of you, actually.

kevin.yamamoto.zeit.0.text: Officer-san, so sorry. I have photographed this seagull for many days, and you defeated him in one afternoon. Very interesting. May I photograph you instead?

kevin.maxwell.zeit.0.text: Brother! In the village they say the seagull challenged you to a duel and you won on points. Mr. Maximum demands a rematch. With the seagull.

kevin.chiara.zeit.0.text: The bar says you rang the church bell with your head to scare the bird away. I give the story a nine. I give you a four.

kevin.charly.zeit.0.text: You fought a seagull on a church. Three out of ten. The seagull was a seven.

kevin.alva.laden.0.text: You went out through my attic window and came back through it with feathers in your hair. Best thing that's happened in that attic in years, o figliolu.

kevin.toto.laden.0.text: Comandante! My lighter! You found my lighter in the nest! I bet the whole crew it was gone forever. I lost, and I've never been so happy losing.

kevin.petru.laden.0.text: Hm. The gull. I tried for six years. You, one afternoon. Hm.

kevin.isabelle.laden.0.text: Officer! Frederico says you can talk to birds now. He wants you to tell the pigeons to stop sitting on my herbs. I want that too, honestly.

red_trio.alva.laden.0.text: They say you went up into the macchia after three people in red and came back with a red jacket and no answers for anyone. Not even for me, o figliolu, and I always get the answers.

red_trio.elsa.zeit.0.text: First Officer. I have three statements from the macchia on my desk. They are long, and they are honest, and I don't like any of them. Thank you for bringing them.

red_trio.elsa.zeit.1.text: First Officer. I have one statement from the macchia on my desk. One. I have read it twice, because there is nothing else to read.

red_trio.lola.zeit.0.text: Mate, the village says you beat three ninjas in red and then made them all a cup of tea. Don't tell anyone I told you, but I reckon the tea won. Mostly the biscuits.

hafen.pascal.zeit.0.text: I told them about the boar again, Duc. It's bigger now. You're welcome. Madame says the steps have never looked so heroic.

kloster.pascal.zeit.0.text: Duc. I heard what you found up there. You don't have to talk about it. If you need anything for the brothers, leave it with me.

berge.pascal.zeit.0.text: The village says you carried Petru's daughter down the mountain on your back. I didn't correct them. Petru didn't either, and from Petru that's a speech.

kevin.pascal.zeit.0.text: Now the gull has a sword, I'm told. I've written it in the town minutes. Somebody should.

hafen.mina.zeit.0.text: They say you hit the boar so hard it flew over the church! I don't spread it. I just deliver it. Everywhere. Very fast.

kloster.mina.zeit.0.text: Nonna gave me double cake this week. She never does that. So I know it was you who went up there. Thanks.

grotte.mina.zeit.0.text: People want me to deliver letters to your smugglers' cave now. I told them no. Then I asked how much.

kevin.mina.zeit.0.text: I saw you on the bell tower from the Vespa! You screamed at a seagull, and the seagull won on points!

hafen.batu.zeit.0.text: They say you fought a bear with a stick. You? So thin? Eat first. Then you tell me about the bear.

kloster.batu.zeit.0.text: Fiora told me what you did on the mountain, con. She doesn't say thank you, so I say it. Sit. I made too much.

berge.batu.zeit.0.text: Petru's girl is home, and they say because of you. Good. Now I can ask her when the baby is coming.

hafen.sandru.zeit.0.text: Ha, the boar again. In my shop they say you rode it. I'd have liked to see that. I'd have liked to do that, actually.

grotte.sandru.zeit.0.text: Ha, sorry, people keep asking me if we sell treasure maps now. We don't. I checked the system. I checked twice.

kevin.sandru.zeit.0.text: Ha. You went up the tower, the whole way up, on your own legs. Sorry. It's nice, that's all. Do you need a bag?

hafen.anghjulu.zeit.0.text: Yes, yes, the bell was wrong that day. I was praying, my son. Very deeply. Let's talk about the boar instead.

kloster.anghjulu.zeit.0.text: You went up to the brothers, my son. Somebody had to. Cut the cards, will you? My hands aren't good today.

grotte.anghjulu.zeit.0.text: They say you gave the whole smugglers' treasure to the church. I believe it, my son. I believe it very much. When does it arrive?

kevin.anghjulu.zeit.0.text: My son, you fought that devil on my tower! Fourteen years I've tried! Next time take wine up there, it helps the aim.
